svg.title: AIGDOS · run-request sequence
svg.desc: Charge-meter example · successful execution, independent review, then human acceptance. Solid arrows: calls, reads or writes. Dashed arrows: returned data/results. The sequence shows the successful path. Documentation of shipped behavior, not a new test result. OBS65 / CAP16 remain blocked; no full-release qualification.

g.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, PingFang SC, sans-serif
g.text: Charge-meter example · successful execution, independent review, then human acceptance
The CLI lane groups runtime.py with the task, Worker and Godot adapters. Calls are condensed; time flows downward.
Save request, scaffold, binding marker and doctor.json
Write layout data + layout-tool.json; commit input files
Create / resume task in separate processes
Save worker-preflight.json; the base adapter supplies the tool binding
Register the actual writer before publishing source
Write declared source; save writes.json with file hashes
Import / load project, then execute tests/check.gd
Return actual outcomes, logs and pass-token observation
Claim with commit + evidence refs; send handoff
Captured evidence: <run>/evidence/ · result.json remains the original run record after later review.
On caught execution failure: preserve workspace + failure.json; early rejection may precede workspace creation.
The assigned reviewer checks the real implementation and evidence before submitting a verdict. This panel shows PASS.
Use actual task and handoff IDs
Live task, handoff and commit binding
Inspect the actual implementation commit, source, layout and Godot evidence
Read the actual artifacts and command results
Perform needed checks; write real findings to review/review.md
Retain actual review and closure outputs for subsequent acceptance
PASS requires independent participation, matching commit bindings and no open handoffs; it is not human acceptance.
reject returns the runtime task to IN_PROGRESS. Review transitions do not edit the work product.
review/review.md and saved closure output are reviewer-created files, not automatic run-request outputs.
3 · Obtain human acceptance — a separate Whiteboard task
Whiteboard root: <run>/project. The shared task is prepared explicitly; it is not automatically imported from the runtime.
Keep originals; copy selected reports / review output into the project
For example: docs/acceptance/charge-meter/; retain commit/hash bindings
Present the agreed criteria and bound evidence
Inspect evidence; check every criterion; confirm acceptance
Project-local records: .dev_os_meta/project_board/tasks/ · evidence_snapshots/ is a sibling of tasks/.
Whiteboard accepted and runtime CLOSED are distinct. Human rework returns the board task to in_progress.
Check confirmation_current separately from workspace_matches_evidence; Console refresh is not acceptance.
Solid arrows: calls, reads or writes. Dashed arrows: returned data/results. The sequence shows the successful path.
Documentation of shipped behavior, not a new test result. OBS65 / CAP16 remain blocked; no full-release qualification.
